rationale_md: Egypt enters this Group G encounter as the clear favorite, backed by a 150-point Elo advantage over New Zealand that reflects their stronger international pedigree and recent form. The Pharaohs' technical quality and experience at major tournaments should give them the edge in controlling possession and creating chances against the All Whites, who have historically struggled to impose themselves against African opposition. New Zealand will need to maximize set-piece opportunities and defensive organization to overcome the gap in class, though their home confederation support may provide some intangible benefit.
